Neo series · N1

Neo Genesis

Released December 16, 2000 · 111 cards

Neo Genesis is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Neo series, released in English on December 16, 2000. It has 111 cards. It includes 81 Pokémon, 21 Trainer and 9 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Neo Genesis. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (50), Keiji Kinebuchi (12), Atsuko Nishida (6), Shin-ichi Yoshida (5), Tomokazu Komiya (5), Hironobu Yoshida (4), Naoyo Kimura (4), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (4).
